footer.legal: FrameSight is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Digital Extremes. Warframe, its names, icons and artwork belong to Digital Extremes.
footer.tagline: A free, open-source Warframe companion for Linux, Windows and the Steam Deck.

closer.title: Your next relic is already cracking.
closer.text: Install FrameSight now, and the next reward screen will tell you which card to take.

stage.demoAlt: Warframe's Void Fissure reward screen with FrameSight's overlay: under each of the four reward cards, a slip shows its platinum and ducat value, and the best of each metal is crowned.
stage.reader: Priced from players in game now

kiosk.alt: A Ducat Kiosk mock: pick tiles to add them to the sell list.

app.description: A free, open-source Warframe companion: platinum and ducat values on the Void Fissure reward screen and Baro's Ducat Kiosk, a priced collection, a mastery checklist and warframe.market order management.
app.ogAlt: Four Warframe reward slips with platinum and ducat values, the best of each crowned.
